record_title: Complemented essential-norm witnesses for finite-fiber band-dominated maps
provenance: A finite-propagation approximation and recursive separation of finite coordinate blocks produce a 1-complemented disjoint l_p or c_0 copy on which the operator is bounded below arbitrarily close to its classical essential norm. The witness yields exact strictly-singular ideal distances and the asymptotic Bernstein profile.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem requires finite-dimensional coordinate fibers, local finiteness of the metric space, and matching outer l_p exponents (or c_0 on both sides); it does not cover l_infinity-sums. The Rabinovich--Roch--Silbermann 2004 monograph and Roch's 2022 paper on ideals of band-dominated operators were not exhaustively inspected theorem by theorem, so an older equivalent formulation cannot be excluded.
